title: GoPro to Be Acquired in $285M Deal, With Public Listing Intact
dek: GoPro is set to merge with an AI infrastructure company in a $285 million transaction while continuing to support its consumer camera products and remaining publicly traded.
socialCaption: GoPro is set to merge with an AI infrastructure company in a $285M deal while remaining publicly traded. Its consumer products will continue to receive support; the bigger question is how the combined company connects a camera brand with AI infrastructure.
